{{Dialogue|Mace Windu|There's a more important reason for your not being informed about the transceiver. It contained a stored message - a message transmitted to Viceroy Gunray from Darth Sidious.|Palpatine|Sidious. I know the name.|Yoda|Dooku's Sith Master, Sidious is. Learned of him on Geonosis, Master Kenobi did. But eludes us, proof of him has.|Palpatine|Now I recall.|Yoda|Obi-Wan was told that this Sidious had somehow infiltrated the Senate. Dismissed that, we have. But lying about Sidious, Dooku wasn't.|attr=Mace Windu, Palpatine, and Yoda regarding the investigation into Darth Sidious|src=<ref name="Labyrinth" />}}
The '''hunt for Darth Sidious''' was a mission that the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] undertook to locate and apprehend the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] that eluded the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for over a decade. The effort started on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] after [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|the battle]] there alerted the Jedi to a [[Mechno-chair/Legends|mechno-chair]] that provided the Jedi a chance to locate the Sith Lord. The mechno-chair also enabled for the Jedi to follow a trail that led them to the Sith's lair in the abandoned [[LiMerge Building/Legends|LiMerge Building]] in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Industrial District/Legends|industrial district]].<ref name="Labyrinth" />

But Sidious himself soon became aware that the Jedi were attempting to hunt him down and decided to use that to his advantage. He ordered his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to divert the Jedi investigation and to kill [[Thal K'sar|two]] [[Fa'ale Leh|loose ends]] that could have further led the Jedi to him. These efforts failed and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] managed to begin investigating the LiMerge Building. But Sidious prepared for this and with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] coordinated a [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|sudden attack]] on Coruscant in order to throw the Jedi off his scent. This venture succeeded in part: the Jedi were diverted but [[Aurek Team]] engaged Sidious and his droid forces. Sidious revealed his face to [[Dyne|one officer]] before the latter died from his injuries. This ended the investigation into Sidious and preserved his secret leading [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to believe that Sidious fled offworld.<ref name="Labyrinth" />

==Background==
The [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]] revealed themselves to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] [[Duel on Tatooine/Legends|first]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|then]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] but in the decade after remained silent and did not return to prominence as the Jedi suspected would be the case. In this time, the Order questioned whether [[Darth Maul/Legends|the Sith Lord]] killed on Naboo had been a master or an apprentice, and debated the possibility of a so-called "[[Second Sith theory|Second Sith]]".<ref name="Phantom">{{Film|I}}</ref> [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] - himself revealed to be a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] - revealed to the captured [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] that a Sith named [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] held influence over several [[Senator/Legends|senators]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]; it was the first such time that the Jedi learnt about Sidious in name.<ref name="Attack">{{Film|II}}</ref>

[[File:Sidious_Son_of_Dathomir.png|thumb|left|300px|Darth Sidious was the shadowy puppet master of the Clone Wars]]
The Jedi were unable to secure further information on Sidious throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] despite their suspicions that the "Second Sith" could be someone in the inner circle advising the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], with such people as [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] and [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] as possible suspects.<ref name="RotSNovel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref><ref name="Labyrinth" />

In the last month before the war ended the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] secured a [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|much-needed win]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] but failed in their attempt to capture the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] leaders [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] and [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]]. But this failure became a greater success in the sense that the Republic managed to secure a [[Mechno-chair/Legends|mechno-chair]] that gave them their first glimpse of Darth Sidious himself. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] decided that the time had come to find and capture the elusive Sith Lord and believed that the mechno-chair was the first positive step in that direction.<ref name="Labyrinth" />

The Council dispatched [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Obi-Wan Kenobi and Jedi Knight [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to follow clues that could lead them to Sidious and decided at first to keep the investigation a Jedi affair without reporting it to the Supreme Chancellor. But the battle at [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]] prompted [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to inform Palpatine about their investigation. Palpatine - as Sidious - summoned his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] Count Dooku to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where the pair discussed the Jedi's initiative. Sidious tasked Dooku with diverting the Jedi however possible to keep them off his trail while also ordering him to take care of those loose ends that could lead the Jedi to him and to their hidden base.<ref name="Labyrinth" />

==The hunt==
{{Quote|Yoda believes that the mechnochair may yield clues to the whereabouts of Darth Sidious. He wants us to take up the search.|Obi-Wan Kenobi informs Anakin Skywalker about their new mission to search for Darth Sidious|<ref name="Labyrinth" />}}
===Charros IV===
Kenobi and Skywalker arrived on [[Charros IV/Legends|Charros IV]] to meet the [[Xi Charrian/Legends|Xi Char]] with the former Trade Federation [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[TC-16]] (captured on Cato Neimoidia) in tow to act as a translator. The purpose to their visit was to question the Xi Char about engravings that were found on the mechno-chair belonging to a certain Xi Charrian named [[t'laalak-s'lalak-t'th'ak]]. He answered the questions put to him but became nervous and attempted to flee. The commotion sees the Jedi chase the Xi Charrian through a warehouse which caused major disruptions before he was caught. He answered their questions while the Xi Charrian prelate arrived and demanded that Kenobi and Skywalker leave due to the disruptions caused. The Jedi learnt that the chair came to Charros IV from [[Escarte/Legends|Escarte]].<ref name="Labyrinth" />

===Escarte===
{{Quote|He needed someone of great skill. Someone willing to follow his every instruction without question. The designs he sent were like nothing I had ever seen. The end result was almost &hellip; artistic.''"<br />"''Why did he allow you to live afterwards?''"<br />"''I was never sure. I knew I'd been useful. I thought he might require additional devices, but I never heard from him again.''"<br />"''If you're right about your arrest, that means he has been keeping an eye on you.|Thal K'sar and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Labyrinth" />}}
The Jedi arrived at Escarte but the authorities there were denied the chance to land. But Skywalker harassed the patrol ships to land to the point where a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] guided their ship to the landing platform. The base's captain arrived to arrest them but en route reveals that he is the [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] agent [[Travale]]. Kenobi and Skywalker are thrown into a cell with the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Thal K'sar]] (the one who worked on the chair) but Travale's cover is blown and he too is incarcerated.<ref name="Labyrinth" />

But Travale manages to cause a power failure that enables the four to escape. Kenobi and Travale go to deactivate the tractor beam to allow their ship to leave the planet while Skywalker and K'sar get to the ship. Skywalker further interrogates K'sar who revealed there were two chairs and that the one he worked on in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] contained a [[Hyperwave transceiver/Legends|hyperwave transceiver]] and a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]]. K'sar elaborated that Darth Sidious himself contacted him and once the chair was completed never heard from the Sith Lord again. It was at that stage that K'sar realized that his recent death sentence was Sidious attempting to cover up his tracks. K'sar also told Skywalker that the chair he worked on ended up on an [[Scimitar/Legends|experimental craft]] and told them that the Jedi could find the pilot in hiding on [[Naos III/Legends|Naos III]].<ref name="Labyrinth" />

===Naos III===
Darth Sidious hoped to set up a trap on Naos III and instructed Dooku to hire assassins to kill [[Fa'ale Leh]] and Kenobi also. The Jedi arrived on the planet and searched several [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] looking for a trace of Leh. The two managed to locate the [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] who assumed the name "Genne" in order to escape those pursuing her since she revealed to the Jedi that those who worked on the ship were all killed off not long after she delivered the ship to [[Darth Maul/Legends|the client]]. Leh was aware that K'sar was the sole survivor besides herself.<ref name="Labyrinth" />

But assassins cornered the three before she could answer additional questions. Leh's right [[Lekku/Legends|lek]] was lost during the escape but she managed to tell the Jedi that she delivered the ship to a building in Coruscant's [[Industrial District/Legends|industrial district]]. Leh also told them that she delivered it to someone who looked like a Jedi but was not because [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|their]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was different.<ref name="Labyrinth" />

===Coruscant===
The failure on Naos III prompted Sidious to order [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to accelerate their plans [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|to attack Coruscant]] as the last-ditch attempt to divert the Jedi. He likewise instructed Dooku [[Recapture of Tythe|to act]] as bait on [[Tythe/Legends|Tythe]] to divert Skywalker and Kenobi while he would deal with those hunting him down on Coruscant.<ref name="Labyrinth" />

Mace Windu and [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] led [[Aurek Team]] and several [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] into the LiMerge Building with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dyne]] leading the investigation. His assessment of the building confirmed that Dooku met with Sidious in the building and it led the group to a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] that in turn led them to tunnels leading them towards the direction of the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]]. Examining those tunnels led them to a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] that would lead them to [[500 Republica/Legends|500 Republica]] but a sudden jolt in the building forced the Jedi to leave to investigate and to learn that Coruscant was under attack. The clones continued their search and found a door in the tunnel with one sentient behind it and droids as well.<ref name="Labyrinth" />

The following commotion saw the entire team slain save for Dyne who in his final moments looked upon Sidious to see that he was in fact Supreme Chancellor Palpatine.

==Aftermath==
{{Main|Showdown on Coruscant}}
{{Quote|I think Chancellor Palpatine is a Sith Lord.''"<br />"''A Sith Lord?''"<br />"''Yes, the one we've been looking for.|Anakin Skywalker and Mace Windu|<ref name="Revenge">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
[[File:Coruscant_Duel.png|thumb|right|210px|Palpatine duels Mace Windu after it is revealed the former is Darth Sidious.]]
The Jedi failed to locate and capture the Dark Lord and the clones that picked up the search beneath Coruscant were killed in the attempt to apprehend the Sith Lord. The Council believed that Sidious fled offworld but did not learn until around a week later that Sidious was in fact Supreme Chancellor Palpatine. This revelation led to a Jedi [[Showdown on Coruscant|attempt to arrest]] the Sith Lord; [[Agen Kolar/Legends|the]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|four]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Jedi]] were each slain and the Dark Lord succeeded in his decade-long plan to convert Anakin Skywalker to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] as his third Sith apprentice, Darth Vader. Later, Kenobi informed Skywalker's secret wife, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], that Palpatine was a Sith Lord whom the Jedi had been searching for and who had been behind the Clone Wars.<ref name="Revenge" />
